# This directory holds the generated RAG embeddings index.
#
# index.json is generated by running:
#   npm run prompts:build
#
# It is git-ignored by default (see .gitignore) because:
#   1. It can exceed 10MB with binary float arrays
#   2. It is fully regenerable from source module files
#   3. It changes whenever any module is edited
#
# To commit the index to the repo (e.g. for CI without build step):
#   Edit .gitignore and uncomment: !embeddings/index.json
#
# Schema of index.json:
# {
#   "version": "1.0",
#   "builtAt": "2026-02-20T...",
#   "chunks": [
#     {
#       "id": "sha256-first-16-chars",
#       "moduleId": "M03",
#       "heading": "Anomaly Detection — 9 Signals",
#       "content": "...",
#       "embedding": [0.123, -0.456, ...],   // 384-dimensional vector
#       "tokenEstimate": 312,
#       "lastUpdated": "2026-02-20T..."
#     }
#   ]
# }
